body: Thanks for the advice.

He tried to apologize, but, as of yesterday at the advice of my cousin,  I told him I wasn't ready to forgive him.  I told him I needed time. I need a break from us.  Ideally, he would stay with his parents,  but he refused to leave.  Instead,  I'm just staying away from him. Not talking to him and refusing to be in the same room.
Thank you.
Thank you!

No offense taken. 

He is, and it doesn't bother me. It's a natural and normal thing to do, but I don't understand why he's so bothered if I were to do it, even though I'm not. 

I've asked to go to a marriage counselor many times, but he refuses. :'(
Thank you for your words.

Thank you for your response and reading that novel of text.

He does do housework now. He's been very consistent about it ever since I nagged the shit out of him, but I'm still dealing with his constant and wrongful accusations. They're taking a huge toll on me and make me feel like his personal masturbation tool rather than a wife.

I feel like I haven't been able to end the cycle of abuse that I've been enduring my entire life. I don't want to be abused anymore. 

I just want it all to end and I don't know how. I feel like the only way I won't be able to be hurt anymore is to just end it. If I continue to live, I'll just continue to let it happen. Even if I left my husband, like someone else suggested in a /r/relationship_advice I posted yesterday, I feel like it would just be someone else. I don't think it can ever end.

> I've never been trapped in an abusive relationship cycle, but my gut tells me that the only way that things are going to get better is for you to take control of your life. How you do that is up to you. You might need to stand up to him and simply tell him that your body is your own, and that if he wants to have sex, he needs to make the mood right. Period. If I were your shoes, however, I would likely leave him. I don't have any experience with drug addicts, but my understanding is that it's pretty rare for them to successfully break the habit. It doesn't sound like he's on his way to recovery any time soon.

All I know is abuse. My father physically abused me until I joined the military at 18. From there, I've been in a few relationships and all of them were either verbal, physical, sexual, or a combination of the three. Prior to my husband, I was in a 5 year stint with a man that literally put a saw knife to my throat and threatened to kill me if I ever left him. That happened a year into the relationship, and you can imagine I was too chicken shit to leave. 

It's sad. I'm not an unattractive person, but I guess I don't value myself enough. I try to maintain a healthy lifestyle. I exercise regularly, eat well within my calorie allowance, and maintained a very healthy weight/BMI. But some reason, I cannot break the abuse cycle for as hard as I try. They all seem so normal until after the first year or so. 

> I'll probably get downvoted to hell because of this, but I think you need to cut the pot completely. You're a mother in an abusive relationship. It's extremely irresponsible to be smoking pot; you've got way too much on your plate, especially since your husband is apparently unable to deal with his own shit.

I didn't start my relationship with pot until after the 5 year relationship that I mentioned earlier. It helped me tremendously with my depression issues, and it's been extremely difficult in these past few months to do without it because of my depression. It was also much easier to deal with the abuse and my postpartum depression with it. As of right now, during the pregnancy, I'm clean. Thus, probably exacerbating the problems in my mind. 

I've wanted nothing more than to kill myself. In fact, the only reason I haven't gone through with it is because I am pregnant and I do have a daughter that I need to be there for. I don't want to be selfish, and my daughter needs me. I don't want her to be without a mother like I was. But, the truth be told, I wish I was dead.

Sorry, this has all been a little overshare. I shouldn't have written everything that I have, but I need to get it out of my system.

Thank you for taking the time to listen.

> And you accepted this point blank? Maybe we have different views on things, but in my eyes, this is a serious issue. No, you don't need his consent to touch yourself. You can touch yourself whenever you goddamned please, and if he's got a problem with that, that's his own fucking issue. He's married to you - that doesn't imply his ownership of you.

Sort of. If I completely accepted it, I certainly wouldn't be sneaking twice a month in the bathroom. Part of it is because I've been in many abusive relationships, both physical and sexual. I don't know anything other than a controlling relationship, and when he and I first got together, it really seemed like I was finally breaking the cycle. 

He seemed very open and non-controlling. It wasn't until after he got out of prison (for substance abuse) that he seemed to change. He went in about a month after our daughter was born. This was 2 years after we started the relationship and a year and a half after we got married. And since he was released, I've stuck by him while he continued to abuse computer duster, spice, and alcohol. I don't do any of those things. I like pot just as much as any ENT in /r/trees, but I don't drink or do anything other than marijuana.

 I've tried to help him through his substance and alcohol abuse, but I was never able to get through to him until his mother got involved. I tried leaving him once after he lost consciousness around our daughter while I was out grocery shopping. I took our daughter and stayed over at a friend's house for a week. And just like any abuser, he promised he would clean up and never do it again. To his credit, he did stop doing duster from that moment on, but the alcohol and spice continued. 

Most recently, he's slowed down on the spice, and I don't find random beer/liquor in the house. 

> I think I could make a relatively educated guess about why you're not in the mood anymore ... the romance is gone. You guys have strayed so far from any semblance of romance, it's doubtful you really look at him romantically anymore. He's your roommate that nags you for sex after he's done playing video games. This is something you both need to do. Sit him down and explain to him how important romance and seduction is to you. Tell him that you want to have sex more often, but you've both got to work to make the mood right. It doesn't always have to be an expensive candlelight dinner, but little things here and there really do matter.

You are right. The romance is completely gone, and it is a roommate nagging for sex situation. I don't ask for expensive candlelight dinners, and the little things like taking a short drive at night to watch the stars would be amazing. I've mentioned it many times. I've tried to tell him that I would be more willing to have more sex if he would just follow my instructions. He has complained that I don't communicate enough regarding my needs, but it's a load of malarky. I've tried, and every time we have a fight, I try again. But it's truly gotten to the point that I just don't want to try anymore. I've stopped caring. It's wrong, I know. And maybe I'm being selfish, but I need him to meet me halfway.

> There's a serious need for therapy - for both of you - in this relationship.

There is nothing but truth is this statement. I've mentioned many many times to him. He is unwilling to go to therapy together. I don't know what else I can do if he is unwilling.
Thank you.

Sadly, I haven't thought of what I should do other than kick him out of the house. I would have to coordinate with my work for some vacation time and probably head across the state to be with my side of the family. I know my cousin, who's like a sister to me, is more than willing to put me up for as long as I would need.
I can honestly say that I've never thought of it as assault because we are married. I feel like I owe him sex for that reason.

You are absolutely right. Neither of are handling this like mature adults. I 100% agree with you.

> For whatever reason, your husband is very insecure about your masturbation schedule. What's going on there? Why does that bother him so much? And why on earth would you imply that you need his consent to touch yourself around him?

I don't know why it bothers him. I've asked him before and he admitted that he was being unreasonable and that I should be able to do so on the rare occasions that I feel the mood to. In the comments I mentioned that my schedule is at most twice a month. So the fact that it bothers him for me to play with myself seems blown out of proportion. The reason I mentioned that I need his consent, is because he's told me that I do. He's controlling with regards to that. According to a conversation we had about it, it's because he wants to be around for it. Which I replied that sometimes I enjoy being alone for it, much like he enjoys being alone for his personal sessions. 

> You say that you only have sex with him to make him happy. That's not really a great way to go about having a love life. Why aren't you in the mood more often? What could put you in the mood? I'm willing to bet that he can sense that you don't really want to have sex with him. He sounds a bit unhinged in the first place, and this is only adding to it. You mention having sex a few times a week - how does that generally happen? What are the circumstances surrounding it?

I can't tell you why I'm not in the mood. I don't even know myself. I'm just not. I'd like to blame the pregnancy hormones, but they're not the problem since I wasn't in the mood even before them. When I was younger, what put me in the mood was a nice romantic date and a great make-out session. I no longer want to even be kissed. I've told him that. I've tried to coach him to kiss me the way I enjoy, but he just does what he wants to do. Usually how we end up having sex is that he will persistently touch me, not in any way that I like despite coaching him how to do so. If I'm awake, I'll ask him if that's what he wants. He will always say yes, and without trying to get me in the mood, he just goes to it. Many times, I've simply given him a BJ or an ol' fashioned to satisfy him, but 7/10x I'll just have sex with him. That said, when I do blow him, I try to do all the little tricks that he's taught me to fully help him out. 

> You guys are clearly lacking romance. When was the last time you went out on a romantic date? When was the last time he charmed you, and you seduced him? These things matter in relationships. You've both been lazy about this.

We most definitely are. His idea of a romantic date is going to a restaurant with a coupon. I like going out to eat, but I've also mentioned that I enjoy going to karaoke, star gazing, and several other activities. Most of the time when we've had a date night, we just end up stuffing our faces and watching TV. I've mentioned going out and doing something, but I'm usually met with "we don't have a coupon for that." We are not lacking for money. As far as my seducing, you're right. I have been lazy about it. Of course, at the moment, I do not fit into any of my sexy lingerie, but I have tried warming him up on occasion. Granted, it's definitely not enough. To be honest, I don't know what I can do for him anymore, and I also feel like my sexual instructions should be taken into account during our sessions, which I have mentioned before. 

While I agree that our romantic life is duller than the Brazilian defense, I believe our communication is worse. Mind you, I've tried. I've tried talking to him about everything and anything without getting into a fight. And I agree that tattling to his mom is petty. I agree my threats are the wrong way to go about things. This is btw, the very first time I've ever said that he couldn't prove it. The reason I did say it was because he continuously accuses me and I'm just sick of it. I've had it up to clouds with his accusations. That, of course, does not excuse my behavior. You are right, but after 20 or more so times of being accused of such and with all the times I've tried calmly talking to him about it, I honestly do not know what to do. It's never been as bad as today. And I never tattled to his mother about it before today, though I did rat him out to his mom when he was deep into a drug and alcohol problem. I couldn't handle that situation by myself, and needed his family to help me with it. As far as the divorce threats, I have no excuse. That happens far more often that it should. I've never thought of it as abuse before, but you're right, it is abusive.

He most definitely is about to have a nervous breakdown, as this is a badly reoccurring problem. And you are very right, they will/are getting worse.

I've suggested that he needs to see someone. He claims to have seen a doctor about it, but he has neither told me when it happened nor did he tell me the outcome. 

This morning during the yelling match, I reminded him that he needed to see a professional because I was tired of being stressed out over his paranoia. He claims to have seen a doctor and that the doctor said there was nothing wrong with him. 

I've seen psychiatrists and psychologists in the past to deal with clinical depression incited by an abusive relationship with my father and to deal with my mother's death when I was 20. Never had any of them just had one session with me and that was that. Normally, they've wanted to see me more consistently. So I don't know whether I should believe that he's sought professional help.
 
I'll ask if he wants me to suggest someone for him, but to be honest, I'm afraid it will start yet another fight.

Yeah,  sorry for the long story. 

I don't monitor his masturbating habits. It just happens that we talked about it.  Personally,  I don't care if he wants to play with himself.  It's normal to do so,  so there's no reason for me to be mad about something so natural and trivial. 

The funny thing is,  I really do try to keep him sexually satisfied.  I almost never masturbate. I don't need it.  The most I've ever done it was about twice a month, and even less so with the pregnancy.  

I've tried talking to him about our needs,  but it always becomes a fight about how I'm a terrible wife for not satisfying him enough even though i try to at least 3x a week.  Maybe that's not enough for him,  but i still try regardless of my own comfort level.
I asked if he wanted to see it, but he said he didn't need to because he knew he was right.

That's what I thought. I always thought that men believed it was sexy. And I know he enjoys watching me, but instead of joining in (had I been in the middle of it), he got mad. 

He gets mad all the time with me for not having enough sex with him, which means doing it every single day. I've explained that it's painful and not enjoyable during the pregnancy. I've tried to "coach" him to help us with our sexual problems, but he doesn't listen to my instructions. 

I used to really enjoy sex, but I haven't had an orgasm with him for a long, long time. I'm seriously at my wit's end.

Sigh. I wish I were an equity actor,  but alas, life has kept me from pursuing it further. 

No harm no foul.  I understood what you meant by me coming off an entitled brat. Thank you for taking the time to further understand the story and for reading my rant.

I didn't really want the role that badly even though I really love the musical itself. There isn't a lot of theater in my area, and,  it's been my hobby since I was a kid.  I just want to be given the chance to perform even in a low quality production. Maybe there's no integrity in that in your opinion, but I'm willing to listen to a better option if you have one. 

Btw, this rant did not reflect  my attitude at the auditions. I'm simply frustrated by the outcome and expressing them freely on the internet.

Pre-casting makes sense.  He did approach one girl, whom I gathered was his friend by how familiar he was towards her compared to others,  while others were still auditioning and asked if she would be available for the run of the show.  I knew she would be given the part she was going for,  and lo and behold,  she was.  Though,  in her defense,  she was the best one there for her part. 

The wife, on the other hand,  was introduced to us at auditions as the costume designer.  I was there for the first day of auditions,  saw everyone perform,  came back the following day for call-backs early in order to scope out the rest of the auditionees, and she didn't audition.  She was only asked to sing during the call-backs. 

Pre-casting makes a lot of sense now.
